comments.author: khaledh
comments.why: Molecular animations of cell machinery that inspire awe
comments.text: When I watch animations of how the cell works at a molecular level [0], I can't help but wonder how can this level of sheer complexity in dna transcription, protein production, and many other supporting functions in a single cell works in perfect harmony. It's mind boggling. I admit that I'm biased, but I don't think this could have evolved through random processes. I'm a believer in Intelligent Design. [VIDEO] [LINK] [LINK]
